test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As on August 2022, the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM) Yojana, is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme for providing monthly minimum assured pension of _____ after attaining the age of 60 years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹3,000.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• On** March 5, 2019**, Prime Minister Narendra Modi unveiled the** Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan pension programme.**
 
• With the help of this massive pension plan, unorganised workers with **monthly incomes **of no more than **Rs 15,000** are protected from financial hardship as they age.
 
• Any unorganised worker between the ages of **18 and 40** whose employment is temporary in nature, including** home-based workers, street vendors, head loaders, brick kiln workers, cobblers, rag pickers, domestic workers, washermen, rickshaw pullers, rural landless labourers, agricultural workers, construction workers, beedi workers, handloom weavers, leather workers,** etc.
 
• The employee should **not **be **enrolled **in any mandatory social security programmes, such as the** National Pension System (NPS), the Employees' State Insurance Corporation programme, **or the **Employees' Provident Fund Organization programme.**
 
• If an unorganised worker joins the programme and has made regular contributions up until the age of **60, **he would receive a pension that is at least** Rs. 3000 per month**.
 
• A monthly family pension equal to **50%** of the **pension **will be paid to the **surviving spouse **after his or her passing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• 
 There is no minimum **level of education required **to join the Scheme.
 
 
• 
 The **subscriber **just needs to **pay **the **set contribution **amount that was established at the time of joining the Scheme.
 
 
• 
 For unorganised workers who are older than **40**, there is **no exception** available for them to join the scheme.
 
 
• 
 When the family pension is informed of a **death **and a **death certificate **is produced, the spouse, if still alive, will automatically be the **beneficiary**.
 
 
• 
 Following the demise of the subscriber and his or her spouse, the **dependents **will **not **be **eligible **for** pension payments.**
